statement: The exact first-homology kernel of the specified common-involution source map is generated by the primitive source class e_0-e_infinity. This remains the kernel over the full profinite integers and over every Z_p. Therefore that discrete inclusion, its full completion, its maximal pro-p variants, and every further target-forgetting composite admit no homomorphic left inverse on the stated domains. No claim about virtual retractions, injectivity of forgotten maps, or triviality of the full equalizer is made.
depends_on: F12 exact source and target maps; F12.14 first-cohomology basis and F12.15 divisor formulas; functorial abelianization
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual induced first-homology map and its coefficient rings are explicitly retained.
computational_checks: code/part_a/common_reflection_retraction.py constructs all twenty divisor rows, kills the puncture-sum relation, checks the primitive kernel, computes rational rank ten, and verifies 24 primary reductions and 480 row equalities.
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part F(b), exact residual centralizer and the specified common-involution quotient.
notes: The exact primitive kernel vector remains nonzero at every primary coordinate. Functorial abelianization rules out left inverses on the stated domains and after target forgetting. The result leaves injectivity of those composites, finite-index target retractions, and the full residual equalizer unresolved.
